name: std::filesystem::path::relative_path
intro: Returns path relative to root-path, that is, a pathname composed of every generic-format component of *this after root-path. If *this is an empty path, returns an empty path.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: Path relative to the root path.

examples.output:
The current path "C:\Users\abcdef\Local Settings\temp" decomposes into:
root-path "C:\"
relative path "Users\abcdef\Local Settings\temp"
